DMs is a locked-down browser for instagram.com/direct.

Known limitations:
• No notifications while the app is closed (WebView can't receive push).
• View-once photos/videos aren't sent to Instagram's website, so they say "open in the app".
• Calling depends on what Instagram's mobile website offers.
• Instagram website changes can break the nav-hiding.

Long-press a photo or video to save it to Pictures/DMs.
